item.text:
HTTPX keeps a connection pool on each default transport and delegates connection reuse, request queuing, and idle connection eviction to **httpcore**. [pyproject.toml](pyproject.toml#L32) · [httpx/_transports/default.py](httpx/_transports/default.py#L135)

- **Clients.** `Client` and `AsyncClient` create and retain an `HTTPTransport` or `AsyncHTTPTransport` by default. For each request, the client selects a transport based on the URL, so a mounted transport can have its own pool. Closing the client closes its transports. [httpx/_client.py](httpx/_client.py#L718) · [async client](httpx/_client.py#L1432) · [client cleanup](httpx/_client.py#L1263)
- **Transports.** `HTTPTransport` wraps `httpcore.ConnectionPool`, and `AsyncHTTPTransport` wraps `httpcore.AsyncConnectionPool`. They translate HTTPX requests into httpcore requests and delegate to `handle_request()` or `handle_async_request()`. For proxied requests, they use the corresponding httpcore HTTP or SOCKS proxy class. [sync transport](httpx/_transports/default.py#L135) · [async transport](httpx/_transports/default.py#L279)
- **Limits.** `httpx.Limits` supplies `max_connections`, `max_keepalive_connections`, and `keepalive_expiry` to the pool. The defaults are **100 concurrent connections**, **20 idle keep-alive connections**, and **5 seconds** of idle keep-alive time. [httpx/_config.py](httpx/_config.py#L159) · [default limits](httpx/_config.py#L247)
